SEMPLICE - LICENSE AND USER AGREEMENT

Version 1.0

Please read this agreement before you use Semplice ("the Program"). By pressing "Accept" in the Program, or by installing, copying or using it, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, press "Exit app" and do not use the Program.

The author of the Program is DonEb14n ("the Author"). The Program's page is https://github.com/DonEb14n/Semplice.


1. WHAT SEMPLICE IS

Semplice is an offline music player with a managed library. You give it music files; it copies them into a library folder that it organises (artists, albums, playlists), keeps a database of what is there, and plays it. The Program works entirely on your computer. It has no accounts, no advertising and no connection to the internet.

3. YOUR MUSIC AND YOUR FILES

Semplice does not provide any music. You are responsible for the files you add to it, and you confirm that you have the right to own and use them. The Author takes no responsibility for the content of your files or for the way you obtain or share them.

When you add music, the Program makes copies of your files in the library folder you choose. Your original files are never moved, changed or deleted by the Program. Inside the library folder the Program renames, moves and rewrites files (for example their tags and cover pictures) to keep them in order. Do not edit the library folder by hand while the Program is running; use the "Rescan" function in the Settings if you change it from outside.

Files that you delete in the Program are moved to the Windows Recycle Bin. They are not erased permanently by the Program.

You are responsible for keeping copies (backups) of your music and of the library folder. The Program keeps small safety copies of its database, but it is not a backup tool.


4. SHARING

The Program can pack a playlist, an album or an artist's discography, including the audio files, into a ".smpl" file, and can add such a file to a library. Only share music that you have the right to share. The Author does not receive, check or store anything that you share, and is not responsible for what is shared with the Program.


5. PRIVACY

The Program does not collect, send or store any personal data outside your computer. The name you may enter in the Settings, your settings and your library stay on your computer. The Program writes a log file with technical information into the Program's data folder; it is never sent anywhere, and you can open and delete it ("Logs folder" in the Settings). If you choose to send a log to the Author, you decide what you send.
